description: PLOS ONE figure specs: Arial/Times/Symbol 8-12pt, width up to 7.5in, 300-600 dpi, RGB; TIFF/EPS submission formats (SVG/PDF kept as editable source, PNG as 300dpi check).
requirements_notes: Width: 789 - 2250 pixels (at 300 dpi). Height maximum: 2625 pixels (at 300 dpi).
Text within figures: Use only Arial, Times, or Symbol font in 8-12 point.
File format: TIFF or EPS only. (This skill additionally keeps SVG/PDF as editable sources and exports PNG at 300 dpi as a check image; convert to TIFF with LZW compression before submission.)
Colour Mode: RGB (8 bit/channel) or grayscale only.

colors.note: PLOS does not mandate a palette; Okabe-Ito colour-blind-safe set used as default
